ISSUE #1: A MONSTER OF A MATRIX

svg.text: The black ink is where a prime divides the degree.
The eye groups that texture into SHAPES — but is it
real, or pareidolia? Lean settles it: every shape below
is a kernel-checked THEOREM. Read on, true believer!
